network.routing.lastAdapter: This adapter is the only exit for a request type. Change the binding before deleting it.
network.routing.title: Request routing
network.routing.invalidType: Enter a unique request type and add an adapter first.
network.adapters.title: Configured Adapters
network.adapters.empty: No network adapters configured. Please add a direct or proxy adapter.
network.adapters.loadFailed: Could not load network adapter configuration
network.form.title: Add Network Adapter
network.form.invalid: Check the adapter ID, URL, weight and rate limits.
network.form.idHelper: Must contain only letters, numbers, _ or -
network.form.urlHelper: Supports http:// and https:// proxies with authentication
network.form.requestsPerSecondHelp: Defaults to 20 requests/second. Window budgets also apply. Save network configuration to apply.
network.form.weightHelper: Higher weight routes a larger proportion of requests
network.policy.title: Health & Circuit Breaker Policy
network.policy.description: Health tracks network and server failures. Upstream throttling uses a separate cooldown policy.
network.policy.failureThresholdHelp: Opens the circuit after this many network failures.
network.policy.cooldownHelp: After this interval, one request probes the exit. Rate limiting pauses it for at least 60 seconds, or longer if requested by the upstream.
network.policy.recoveryBonus: Weight restored after a successful request
network.policy.circuit.title: Circuit breaker & isolation probing
network.policy.circuit.description: Consecutive network failures open the circuit at the threshold. Upstream throttling does not open it.
network.policy.weights.title: Dynamic weight decay & staged recovery
network.policy.weights.description: Scales routing capacity in real time from consecutive request outcomes.
network.execution.title: Execution
network.execution.description: Save to persist and apply to running workers without restarting. In-flight requests retain their original settings. Time fields use milliseconds.
network.execution.snapshotConcurrencyHel: Concurrent snapshot batches; adapter rate limits still apply.
network.execution.discoveryConcurrencyHe: Concurrent discovery tasks. Reducing concurrency does not interrupt active work.
network.execution.admissionTimeoutMsHelp: Wait for tokens first, then defer the job until capacity can be requested again.
network.execution.throttleCooldownMsHelp: Base delay after upstream throttling. A longer Retry-After takes precedence.
network.execution.throttleJitterMsHelp: Adds a random delay between zero and this value.
network.execution.queueCapHelp: Stops claiming videos when active, waiting and delayed jobs reach this total.
network.execution.scopeAdapter: Only the adapter used by this request
network.execution.cooldowns: Upstream cooldowns (scope, seconds remaining, resume time)
network.execution.taskTimeoutMsHelp: Releases the active slot, cancels HTTP and prevents subsequent database operations. Already submitted operations are not rolled back.
network.session.title: Session
network.session.description: Fetch credentials on startup and refresh at the configured interval and midnight in Beijing. Headers and browser identity are chosen dynamically from a comprehensive header dataset.
network.session.recoveryHelp: By default, rebuild and retry only when the response explicitly names invalid WBI, ticket or device credentials. Ordinary throttling defers the task. Only add codes known to indicate credential expiry.
network.adaptive.title: Adaptive request rate
network.adaptive.description: Throttling reduces the exit request rate and further limits background search and details traffic. Successful responses gradually restore the rate. Exit connectivity remains a separate state.
network.execution.probeWaitMs: Wait for an active recovery probe (ms)
network.execution.probeWaitMsHelp: Briefly wait for the single half-open request. When the wait budget ends, defer the task and release its active slot.
network.execution.probeRetryMsHelp: Task delay after exit failures. An open circuit must still complete its cooldown.
network.execution.probeRetriesHelp: Bounds brief waits for another request’s recovery probe.
network.execution.maxNetworkCooldownMsHe: Bounds the next task check, without reopening an exit before its cooldown ends.
network.execution.mqOperationTimeoutMsHe: Bounds Redis commands, progress updates, enqueueing and delayed transitions.
network.execution.inferenceTimeoutMsHelp: Includes inference queueing and model loading. Timeout or task cancellation terminates the inference process; subsequent work starts a new process.
network.routing.requiredTypes: The built-in Bilibili request classes must be retained.
network.execution.throttleFailoverHelp: Off by default. With per-exit cooldowns, replay-safe requests may try other available exits within the same call, respecting cooldowns and the attempt budget. Global cooldowns always defer the request.
